author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: Initial public release (v0.8, 2026-11-11). Control a rooted LG webOS TV running Glasshouse from the Preferences page: power, launch app, send key, a live-apply volume slider (including HDMI ARC volumeStep), mute, input and picture-mode dropdowns populated from the TV, and screen on/off, in grouped sections. Commands tab is just Initialize and Refresh. Requires Hubitat 2.2.0+.
